name: Images
description: Convert images between JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP and TIFF (including from iPhone HEIC photos); inspect them (size, camera, date, location); resize, crop, rotate and adjust; make thumbnails; strip private metadata. Inside the folders you trust.

settings.label: Trusted folders
settings.description: Images can read and write pictures only inside these folders. Originals are never replaced unless asked.

settings.label: JPEG quality
settings.description: 1-100. Used when saving JPEGs unless a call asks for something else.

settings.label: Reveal GPS location
settings.description: Include photo GPS coordinates in results. Off: the AI only learns that a photo has a location.
